entities.summary: Shin Dong-hyuk (b. 1982-11-19, Kaechon internment camp) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kaechon internment camp and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
